digestPreimage: ASCII canonical profile, LF, exact domain, LF, canonical numeric-free tree bytes excluding manifestSha256
scope: one actual original fresh catalog operation; original operation context is not a multi-operation transaction context
memberOrder: numeric original revision, contiguous canonical decimal ordinals from zero; arbitrary kinds refuse this selected scope
catalogPrerequisites: every ordered original accepted UMF document, exact original definition bytes/profile and original revision identity; no current definition reconstruction
configurationPrerequisites: generation-stable configuration projection excluding writerXid, operationOrdinal, contextDigest and clock; exact original epoch/installation/generation/profile/value/producer inventory; the full admitted capsule remains separate owner/source custody
producerProfile: original retained custody producer profile bytes admitted by selected independent reference composition

clockProfile.basis: one server clock_timestamp sample immediately before original custody insertion
clockProfile.envelope: profile plus finite UTC microsecond original-write timestamp; copied unchanged by subsequent feed registration

finalization: separate independently validated finalizer; current registrar leaves manifest/finalized-generation/delivery-ordinal NULL

profilePin.sha256: lowercase SHA256 of exact archived canonical numeric-free bytes of this complete manifestProfile definition; no embedded self digest
profilePin.storage: feed_tx.manifest_profile_bytes copies these exact canonical bytes

feedContext.sourceEpoch: original admitted operation context.sourceEpoch, independently matched to current epoch/configuration
feedContext.feedProfile: this registration recipe identity; exact feed_tx.feed_profile
feedContext.scopeIdentityQualification: fixed candidate scope only; not an ordinary-person disclosure or authorization claim

sourceProfiles.key: exact canonical numeric-free keyProfile bytes from selected custody producer; retained custody field must equal those bytes
sourceProfiles.payload: exact archived bytes and sha256 at payloadProfile; retained custody field must equal those bytes
sourceProfiles.producer: exact archived selected custody producer profile bytes; independent reference roster admits producer before capture

documentMapping.source: original accepted input.documents in order, corresponding exactly to schema_doc.ord/documentId/documentRevision
documentMapping.definitionBytes: decoded original document.artifact.bytesBase64; exact equality with UTF8 schema_doc.document and stored content_sha256
documentMapping.duplicates: keep first artifact identity in original document order when bytes and profile are identical; conflicting bytes/profile refuse
documentMapping.ordering: first occurrence order for registration; final manifest prerequisite sorting follows selected canonical archive identity UTF8 bytes
documentMapping.recipe: packages/postgresql/native/catalog-report/prerequisite-registration-candidate.sql generation artifact and document mapping; no call to its old report-producing entry point

ownerResources.qualification: logical original/chunk/carrier bounds; not complete native allocation or work

resourceLimits.qualification: logical byte and inventory ceilings only; native allocation and work accounting remain unqualified

generationConfigurationDefinition.qualification: generation-stable projection only; the selected old recipe entry point is not executed

configurationArtifactIdentity.bytes: exact original retained generation-stable configuration artifact bytes
configurationArtifactIdentity.digest: direct SHA256 of those original artifact bytes
configurationArtifactIdentity.conflicts: same epoch/installation/generation with conflicting profile/value/inventory refuses; no alternate identity
configurationArtifactIdentity.selection: new complete manifest definition pin before parent creation; no historical reinterpretation

manifestArtifactEncoder.tree: closed numeric-free tagged tree; exact UTF8 key ordering; CONTRACT-009 escaping
manifestArtifactEncoder.originalDocuments: final deduplicated prerequisite order sorted by original artifact identity UTF8 bytes; exact raw original artifact bytes; conflicting same identity bytes/profile refuse before encoding
manifestArtifactEncoder.originalConfiguration: one exact generation-stable original configuration artifact byte sequence
manifestArtifactEncoder.correspondence: exact base64 of original raw arguments; one required string slot per document and one configuration slot; exact array cardinality and object path kinds; no other scalar exemptions
manifestArtifactEncoder.selection: complete new definition selected before feed parent creation; no old-parent reinterpretation
manifestArtifactEncoder.qualification: rollback-only codec component; no finalization, accepted catalog, ordinary-person authorization or public runtime claim
